title: CG7 M.2 statistical qualification of the SM1 and SM2 kernels (Addendum R2.9)
stopping_rule: One locked run of every panel with the seeds below.
An implementation bug reruns the affected panel only; the rerun, its reason and the defect are recorded in the results file next to the original outcome.
A correctly implemented failure is retained; the affected formal standing is disabled and the method falls back to descriptive.
No threshold, panel, seed or acceptance change after the run; no method shopping.
implementation_equivalence: Each simulation uses a vectorized form of the kernel; before a panel counts, the vectorized form must reproduce eprocess.EDetector / eprocess.recovery_upper exactly (alarm units, claim times) on the first 20 trials of that panel. A mismatch is an implementation bug.

Q-E1a.check: SM1 exact enumeration with resets: all 2^20 Bernoulli paths at the boundary null mu = m0; exact E[N_t] and P(N_t >= 1) for every t <= 20
Q-E1a.acceptance: E[N_t] <= t * alpha and P(N_t >= 1) <= t * alpha for every t, exactly (tolerance 1e-12 for floating summation)

Q-E1b.check: SM1 recursion equals the brute-force definition (max over run starts of the product, with resets) and never exceeds the Shiryaev-Roberts statistic
Q-E1b.acceptance: identical alarm units on every path; CUSUM <= Shiryaev-Roberts at every step (relative 1e-12)

Q-E1c.check: SM1 log-space stability over 10^8 units at the boundary null (m0 = 0.05, alpha = 1e-8), chunked Lindley form, cross-checked against EDetector on the first 2e5 units
Q-E1c.acceptance: state finite at every chunk boundary; prefix equality with EDetector to 1e-9 in the log statistic and identical alarms; realized alarm count reported against alpha * units = 1 (informational)

Q-E1d.check: SM2 exact false-claim probability at the constant boundary null (dynamic programme over the running sum, absorbing claim state), and the closed form against numerical integration of the normal mixture
Q-E1d.acceptance: exact P(claim within horizon) <= alpha; mixture integral at the boundary equals 1/alpha to relative 1e-6 on the listed (n, rho, alpha) points

Q-E2.check: SM1 null false alarms with resets by vectorized simulation; n = 2e4 units per trial, alpha = 0.05 / 2e4 (n * alpha = 0.05)
Q-E2.acceptance: fail only if the one-sided exact binomial test of the first-alarm count against n * alpha rejects at 0.001, or the 0.999 one-sided lower confidence bound of the mean alarm count (normal approximation, stated) exceeds n * alpha

Q-E3.check: SM2 null false claims; horizon 2000, rho = 500, alpha_rec = 0.05, minimum support 30; every claim is false because the running average of conditional means is >= theta throughout
Q-E3.acceptance: fail only if the one-sided exact binomial test of the false-claim count against alpha rejects at 0.001

Q-E4.check: SM1 assumption-violation controls (same design as Q-E2); expected inflation, recorded as documented limits, never failures

Q-E5.check: Detection planner validity: sustained shift from the first unit, fresh detector; alpha from a target of 0.1 expected false alarms per 30 days at the stated volume; trials capped at 10x the prediction (capped trials count as the cap)
Q-E5.acceptance: observed median delay within [0.5, 1.5] x the planner's expected delay (qualifies the planner shown to users, not detector validity)

Q-DC.status: deferred to S7 with the domain classifier; locked separately before it runs
